study: DIGR Codex 0.7.0 outcome and resource pilot
research_questions: Under identical allocated resources, does the light preference block improve useful task outcomes over native Codex?
When additional work and collaboration are allowed, does the full DIGR profile improve useful outcomes, including against a native control with the same resource ceilings?
data: Owned synthetic portfolio; no real customer or applicant data; finite local evidence only
primary_outcome: Each task passes all essential external behavioral and artifact checks; also retain individual failures for diagnosis

single_main_experiment.host_preference: CLI if usable; otherwise native fork_none for all arms; never compare across hosts as an isolated protocol effect

collaborative_experiment.U0: Full arm may ask for a researched brief decision; a fixed, explicitly labelled experimental simulated-user response will confirm only the frozen portfolio and ceilings. No real user confirmation will be invented.
collaborative_experiment.faithfulness: Count real responsibilities, isolation, substantive revisits and adopted consequences separately. Partial execution stays partial. Do not manufacture N/R/D/V to make the study complete.

controls: Each subject gets a fresh history and identical initial task bytes and seed code; only the declared instruction condition differs.
No subject sees another arm, evaluator code, gold data, interim scores, or a requested winner.
Freeze acceptance criteria and evaluator before observing outputs. Test seed-bad and correct reference artifacts.
Allow strong native behavior, autonomous useful review, and the same tools and delegated resources where allocated.
Do not tune the protocol or tasks after seeing outcomes. Any required evaluator repair applies symmetrically and is disclosed.
inference_limits: Same ceilings do not imply identical realized token use. Report measured use; do not claim equal-token causality without it.
Four correlated synthetic task families and two repeats are a pilot, not a representative benchmark or a reliable prevalence estimate.
Do not count assertions or protocol unit tests as evidence of useful task performance.
Do not equate more prose, agents, checks or N/R/D/V labels with quality.
Open creative quality, human preferences, long-running real project success and future model versions are outside this pilot.
Report improvements, ties, regressions, censored runs and instrumentation failures, including an inconclusive result.

amendments_before_task_outputs.reason: Audit found native fork_none retains user AGENTS light block; HTTPS-only named provider smoke succeeded in 9.4 seconds using existing ChatGPT auth.
amendments_before_task_outputs.single_main_host: CLI, project_doc_max_bytes=0, memories false, plugins/apps/multi_agent disabled, fresh session; audit exact injected messages before accepting run.
amendments_before_task_outputs.collaborative_host: Native inherited-light host; compare current host baseline with extra resources against full default profile increment; both inherit identical AGENTS.
amendments_before_task_outputs.standard_arm: Not included; no claim about standard profile.

amendments_before_valid_native_outputs.reason: Both native fork_none and shared-CODEX_HOME CLI load global user AGENTS despite project_doc_max_bytes=0. Polluted CLI a01 was stopped and excluded without inspecting efficacy scores. Isolated home smoke removes instructions but primary practical question is the profile increment on this configured host.
amendments_before_valid_native_outputs.actual_primary_design: One host-native single-Main baseline repeated before and after; full-default-profile vs native-extra share 900s/3helper/6turn/2concurrent ceilings. All native arms inherit identical user AGENTS light block.
amendments_before_valid_native_outputs.pure_light_ablation: Not run as efficacy evidence; no claim of a clean light-vs-bare effect.
amendments_before_valid_native_outputs.resource_comparisons: Fixed-ceiling native-extra vs full; extra investment full vs host-native-single, using observed all-in usage and outcomes. Same cap is not equal actual tokens.

visibility_repair_before_full_production.reason: Global list_agents exposes completed sibling answers even when histories are fork_none.
visibility_repair_before_full_production.changes: Explicitly enforce the already-declared no-other-subjects boundary for future parents/helpers. No task inputs, evaluator, acceptance rules or outcome targets changed.
